findings.risk: Data in the bucket could be accessed by anyone on the internet
findings.remediation: Remove or set the acl attribute to private and add an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource with all four blocking settings set to true

findings.risk: Data at rest is not protected with encryption
findings.remediation: Add a server_side_encryption_configuration block with a rule to apply server-side encryption by default

findings.issue: Bucket does not have access logs
findings.risk: Unable to track who accessed the S3 bucket and when
findings.remediation: Add a logging block to enable access logging

findings.risk: Previous versions of objects are not retained, making recovery from accidental deletion or overwrite impossible
findings.remediation: Add a versioning block and set enabled to true
